display_name: Which hat this is (e.g. Acme engagement, Board seat at Example Co.)
notes: Add "acting_for": {"tenant_slug": "...", "organization_id": "...", "org_role": "..."} to name the tenant you act for under this stance, and as which Organization and Org Role (organization_id and org_role are optional). pnpm stance:switch rejects a tenant that is not an active profile in knowledge/personal/tenants/ and binds KYBERION_TENANT / KYBERION_ORGANIZATION_ID to it; without acting_for the stance is only a personal overlay. kind is engagement (acting for an end customer) or affiliation (acting as one of several entities you belong to). Free-form notes are not parsed by Kyberion.
